foreign_injury.open.title.v2: {injured_player_name} absence gives club temporary foreign option
foreign_injury.open.body:
The KBO has approved a temporary foreign-player replacement slot for {team_link} because of {injured_player_link}'s injury. The remaining recovery window is listed at {days_left} days.

During that period, {team_link} may carry one additional {slot_label} foreign player. The approval is relief, not a permanent expansion. Once the original player returns, the club must move back inside the normal foreign-player limit.

foreign_injury.open_roster.body:
{team_link} has received a temporary foreign-player replacement exception after {injured_player_link} was confirmed on the long-term unavailable list. The KBO recognized the roster status and cleared the club to use an extra slot until the player returns.

The exception allows one additional {slot_label} foreign player during the absence. Once the original player is ready for the top roster again, the club must close the exception and move back inside the normal foreign-player limit.

foreign_injury.open_roster.body.v2:
{team_link} gets short-term roster flexibility with {injured_player_link} away from the active group. The KBO has opened a temporary foreign-player exception tied to the player's long-term unavailable-list status.

This is a limited injury measure, not a permanent expansion. When the return process begins, the club will have to fold the foreign-player group back into the standard KBO limit.
foreign_injury.active.title: {replacement_player_name} registered as injury replacement for {injured_player_name}
foreign_injury.active.body:
{team_link} has signed {replacement_player_link} and attached him to the temporary foreign-player exception created by {injured_player_link}'s long-term injury.

For now, {replacement_player_link} is managed as the replacement foreign player rather than a normal extra slot. When {injured_player_link} returns, the club will have to choose which player stays. If the replacement is retained, he will move into the regular foreign-player group and the returning player will be released.
